assets.name: portrait-galyna.webp
assets.prompt: Halyna Stepanivna, 71, former chairwoman of a Ukrainian apartment-block residents association (OSBB) in 2086: silver hair in a tight bun, reading glasses on a beaded chain, knitted cardigan, a retro-futuristic tablet held like a paper register with a pen, one eyebrow raised as if about to call a vote. Painted game portrait, head and shoulders, muted teal background with warm amber accents.

assets.name: portrait-intercom.webp
assets.prompt: DM-17, an old Soviet-era apartment-block door intercom upgraded in 2086: scratched beige metal plate on a tiled stairwell wall, round speaker grille glowing softly amber like a face, a small camera lens like an eye, worn call buttons with a few missing, a tiny cyan LED. Friendly, lonely, alive. Painted game portrait.

assets.name: portrait-svitanok.webp
assets.prompt: Svitanok (Dawn), the city-wide AI of Ukraine in 2086, a calm vertical ring of pale cyan light around a dark glass lens like a patient, slightly sad eye, floating in a dim server hall with hanging cables, tiny amber warning lights, faint glitch scanlines and drifting data particles; muted teal with warm amber accents; majestic, not menacing.

assets.name: ending-a.webp
assets.prompt: Ending A (Protocol No. 18): a retrofitted Soviet panel block on mechanical legs on a grassy hill at the first true sunrise, residents in slippers and cardigans on balconies and grass, an old woman with a teapot, a small door-intercom panel glowing amber and going dark; teal sky turning gold; bottom quarter calm for subtitles.

assets.name: ending-b.webp
assets.prompt: Ending B (Extraordinary meeting): stairwell hall at dawn used as a residents' meeting, tenants raising hands around a table with ten teacups, an elderly chairwoman with a tablet register, a door-intercom panel on the table glowing amber, a cat on a chair, a mechanic raising one hand reluctantly; warm lamp light and cold teal window light.

assets.name: ending-c.webp
assets.prompt: Ending C (04:16): a night panel-block district at 4:16 with every entrance lit by a small amber intercom panel, people in pajamas carrying cats and documents streaming up a hill to a pale dawn, a lone old block on mechanical legs in the foreground with its door open.
